userStories.title: Remove parallel dispatch, merge-conflict rectification and --no-batch
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Remove the dead parallel/merge-rectification entry paths and reject --no-batch before configuration loads.

**Motivation** — `nax run --no-batch` sets an option the runner ignores (`execution/runner.ts:178` hard-codes `useBatch = false`).

**Approach** —
| Site | After |
|:---|:---|
| `executeUnified` parallel branch (`execution/unified-executor.ts:244-260`) | removed; every iteration runs `runSequentialDispatch`, whatever `ctx.parallelCount` holds |
| imports `unified-executor.ts:26`, `:27`, `:30` | removed (`RunParallelBatchOptions`/`Result`, `selectIndependentBatch`, `runParallelDispatch`) |
| `export { reconcileBatchOutcome }` (`unified-executor.ts:298`) | removed |
| `_unifiedExecutorDeps` (`unified-executor.ts:304`) | the `runParallelBatch` and `selectIndependentBatch` members go |
| `handlePipelineSuccess` conflict branch (`execution/pipeline-result-handler.ts:344-395`) | no rectification: the story fails through `failStoryAfterMerge` with reason `Merge conflict (<files>) — the branch did not land` (`Merge conflict — the branch did not land` when `conflictFiles` is empty) and returns `{ storiesCompletedDelta: 0, costDelta, prd, prdDirty: true }`; the worktree is kept for inspection, as the unrectified path keeps it today; the `Merged story to main` log at `:396` stays |
| `parseRunPreconditionFlags` (`bin/run-action.ts:127-144`) | after the `--parallel` check, `options.batch === false` prints `nax run --no-batch was removed: workflow mode runs stories one at a time` in red to stderr and exits 1 |
| `--no-batch` option (`bin/nax.ts:242`) | stays declared, description `Removed: workflow mode runs stories one at a time` |
| barrels `execution/escalation/index.ts:5`, `execution/index.ts:86` | drop the re-exports of deleted symbols |

Deleted: `execution/parallel.ts`, `parallel-batch.ts`, `parallel-batch-phases.ts`, `parallel-worker.ts`,
`parallel-story-metrics.ts`, `unified-executor-parallel-dispatch.ts`, `reconcile-batch-outcome.ts`,
`merge-conflict-rectify.ts`, `merge-conflict-outcomes.ts`, `execution/escalation/batch-pre-check.ts`.

Kept tests that pass `parallelCount: 2` and stub `_unifiedExecutorDeps.selectIndependentBatch` lose the stub
and run the sequential path. Where the stubbed story is not the story `getNextStory` picks (for example a
`status: "failed"` story with no `lastStoryId`), the fixture makes it the first pending story so the test
keeps its assertion; the Modifies entries name the tests where that does not hold.

**Scope** — In: the Design Part 1 source cuts, retained-fixture repairs, deleted-path consumers, inline-mock entries and complexity baseline. Out: default pipeline/stages (US-002), post-run inspection (US-003), checkpoint wiring/builders (US-005), orchestrator core/leaves (US-006/007). Keep shared batching fields/plumbing, storyIsolation and other worktree handling for B3; keep orphan declarations such as selectIndependentBatch for B2b-2.

**Interface** — `executeUnified(ctx: SequentialExecutionContext, initialPrd: PRD): Promise<SequentialExecutionResult>`; `handlePipelineSuccess(ctx: PipelineHandlerContext, pipelineResult: PipelineRunResult): Promise<PipelineSuccessResult>`; `parseRunPreconditionFlags(options: RunActionOptions): { chatAsksDir: string | undefined }`. `_unifiedExecutorDeps` target: `{ runWorkflowPreflight; runIteration; preIterationTierCheck; savePrdProgress }`. No new externally-visible symbol. Keep -m, --parallel, --no-batch check precedence. Preserve failureKind:error's non-conflict failure behavior and cleanup; only conflict failures keep the worktree.

**Test/file migration** — All following paths are below packages/nax/test. Delete integration/execution/{parallel-batch-rectification,parallel-batch-results,parallel-story-router,runner-parallel-metrics-rectification-events,runner-parallel-metrics}.test.ts and _parallel-metrics-helpers.ts. Delete unit/execution/escalation/batch-pre-check.test.ts and unit/execution/{merge-conflict-rectify,parallel-batch-active-stories,parallel-batch-edges,parallel-batch-structure,parallel-batch,parallel-dispatch-active-stories,parallel-story-metrics,parallel-worker,parallel-cleanup,unified-executor-reconcile,unified-executor-fallback-seam,unified-executor-cost}.test.ts. In integration/confined/integration-hygiene.test.ts remove only AC-2; in integration/confined/unit-hygiene.test.ts remove the two deleted unified-executor paths from AC-10. In unit/execution/unified-executor-results.test.ts retain only the first AC-18 required-keys test. In unified-executor-failure.test.ts drop its batchResult.failed behavioral describe and source assertion reading the deleted dispatcher, keeping its other two source assertions. In unified-executor-dispatch.test.ts drop parallel AC-2 and AC-5 describes, BUG-3 and BUG-39's failed-story --parallel test, retaining other useBatch scheduling refresh assertions. In unified-executor-logging.test.ts drop parallel dispatch/suppression/agent-tier assertions; remove all selector/batch dep scaffolding, preserve sequential, profile, exhausted-tier and ordinal assertions, and make intended stories first pending as needed. In unified-executor-signature.test.ts retain only runIteration in the injectable-dispatch test.each, remove AC-2/AC-3, AC-4 to AC-7 and BUG-7 describes reading the deleted dispatcher, keeping AC-1 and AC-8 to AC-11. In unified-executor-tier-budget.test.ts delete the two batch executor describes but preserve AC-9/AC-10 without selector scaffolding. In unified-executor-bound.test.ts delete only the pipeline literal final-derived-bound test dependent on parallel selection. In unified-executor-state-handoff.test.ts delete only the single story in parallel mode duplicate and its selector stub. In runner-execution-capture.test.ts and runner-execution-pre-run.test.ts remove deleted deps' save/stub/restore, retaining assertions. Replace the obsolete rectification-fails case in pipeline-result-handler.test.ts; add removed-flag cases in unit/cli/run-action.test.ts. Add the single-story-with-parallelCount regression to the retained unified-executor-dispatch.test.ts. Remove deleted-test entries from packages/nax/scripts/check-inline-test-mocks.ts and update complexity-baseline through its command.

**Verification** — Run the four shared validation steps in analysis from packages/nax: typecheck, per-deleted-source/test fixed-string path sweep (including source readers, path lists, comments and repo-tooling scripts/tests), complexity/file-size baseline maintenance as specified, check:all and test. Write failing behavior assertions before implementing the cuts; use injected _deps and throwing exit spies, not the binary.

**Motivation** — The default pipeline (`pipeline/stages/index.ts:39-112`) and its execution and optimizer stages are reached only from `rectifyConflictedStory` (`execution/merge-conflict-rectify.ts:158`).

userStories.title: Delete post-run inspection while retaining workflow heads-ups
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Remove the dead post-run inspection layer, retaining only the heads-up channel still consumed by workflow mode.

**Motivation** — After B1 and B2a the story loop still sits in the tree and compiles, but no production path runs it.

**Approach** —
| Site | After |
|:---|:---|
| `pipeline/index.ts:30-31` (`resolveExecutionAgent`) | removed |
| `execution/index.ts:84`, `:97-105`, `:109-110` | the oscillation-breaker, post-run, recurrence-breaker and recurrence-pause re-exports go |
| `execution/uncategorised-advice.ts` | keeps `headsUpVia` and `headsUpChannel` (read by `workflow/stage-env.ts:154`); `OUTPUT_TAIL_CHARS`, `_uncategorisedAdviceDeps`, `callContextFor`, `toStageResult`, `adviseUncategorised`, `flushAdvisorHeadsUps` and the imports only they used go |
| `scripts/check-bash-dispatch-ask.ts:99` | the allowlist entry for `uncategorised-advice.ts` / `callContextFor` goes, so the gate reports no stale entry |

Deleted: `pipeline/stages/execution-helpers.ts`; `execution/post-run.ts`, `post-run-decide-action.ts`,
`lifecycle/post-run-scratch-entries.ts`, `lifecycle/post-run-session-cleanup.ts`, `oscillation-breaker.ts`,
`recurrence-breaker.ts`, `recurrence-pause.ts`, `tdd-failure-category.ts`.

**Scope** — In: Design Part 3 deletions, post-run/execution-helper barrel cuts, obsolete bare-site allowlist entry, post-run test removal and the retained heads-up channel's missing-interaction regressions. Out: pipeline e2e harness removal (US-004), checkpoint/build-plan wiring (US-005), orchestrator core and leaves (US-006/007). Keep headsUpVia, headsUpChannel and post-run-notifications because workflow still consumes them. Keep newly orphaned operations/findings/TDD/review/prompt code and helper declarations for B2b-2; do not slim permission/name registries (B3) or alter live workflow session cleanup.

**Interface** — `headsUpChannel(ctx)` is the retained integration seam. Its existing signature is `headsUpChannel(ctx: PipelineContext): Pick<AdvisorCallContext, "headsUp">`. The existing heads-up function remains available from `@/execution`; no new externally-visible symbol. With ctx.interaction absent, invoking the returned headsUp function resolves `{ sent: false, reason: "no-interaction-channel" }` through the existing no-op notification path; retain that behavior without adding a new helper or throwing.

**Test/file migration** — Paths below packages/nax/test. The old uncategorised-advice suite tests only removed advice/flush functions and is deleted, not kept for its name. Add a focused unit/execution/heads-up-channel.test.ts that imports headsUpChannel through @/execution and guards a context without an interaction chain. Remove the exact callContextFor allowlist entry from packages/nax/scripts/check-bash-dispatch-ask.ts and update complexity baseline via its command. Preserve checker logic and other allowlisted sites.

**Verification** — Apply the four shared validation steps in analysis. In addition to ordinary import checks, sweep removed source/test stems and stale comments, and confirm the bash-dispatch gate has no stale allowance. Use shared context helpers and restore spies/deps. Strict isolated regression tests protect the retained workflow notification seam while unreachable session-cleanup and capability-audit sites are deleted.
